The '''alabaster figurine''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' that was stolen from the [[White Tower]] by the [[Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters|Black Ajah]].{{Ref/book|3|25}}

==Appearance==
The ''ter'angreal'' is in the shape of a unclothed woman, is made of alabaster, and is one hand tall.{{Ref/book|3|25}}

==Use==
The use of the alabaster figurine is unknown. The evidence suggests it is a [[sleepweaver]] because of the circumstances of the theft and also because it was studied by [[Corianin Nedeal]] along the other stolen objects.{{Ref/book|3|25}}
